items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Yeah, I used to play with Tom Benton. Yeah, years ago, me and Tom played together.

ctx.x: Which boy was this? Was he a musician?
Yeah, he was a piano player. And he was, his name was Tom. Well, he did.
Is that Tom Benton? Did you know Tom Benton, by the way? You introduced me to Tom Benton.
